meta.name: Maven Ontology
meta.description: XUNIA Maven ontology graph for Planet xZoon.

nodes.label: Action
nodes.desc: A governed operation in recommend, simulate or approved mode.

nodes.label: Evaluate Public Use Claim
nodes.desc: Recommend verification of the claimed authorization against authoritative terms and actual entitlements. This action does not create credentials, grant access, enroll an account, or execute external side effects.

nodes.label: Agent
nodes.desc: A governed software or human-controlled actor.

nodes.label: Approval
nodes.desc: Human authorization governing an action.

nodes.label: Artifact
nodes.desc: A generated or ingested output with provenance.

nodes.label: Maven Live Sync Smoke Proof
nodes.desc: Harmless provenance artifact proving the approved Maven Live Sync commit path end to end.

nodes.label: 2026 Evolving Threat Assessment
nodes.desc: Assessment that adaptive threat actors increasingly exploit online channels and decentralized mobilization, increasing the importance of provenance, public-tip intake, interagency fusion, and emerging-technology horizon scanning.

nodes.label: Asset
nodes.desc: A governed resource represented in the ontology.

nodes.label: AIPCon 9 Maven Architecture Update Audit Record
nodes.desc: Audit record for ingestion of the public AIPCon 9 multi-domain AI architecture lessons into the XUNIA Maven ontology under existing human-approval and non-autonomous-action controls.

nodes.label: Evolving Threat Update Audit Record
nodes.desc: Provenance and decision-lineage record for the 2026 evolving-threat ontology update.

nodes.label: Capability
nodes.desc: A function available to a mission, agent or system.

nodes.label: Authorized Public Use Path
nodes.desc: Resolve a claimed public-use permission into a bounded, terms-compliant integration path: identify the actual product, verify eligibility, use only issued credentials, preserve provenance, and restrict actions to the granted scope.

nodes.label: Emerging Technology Horizon Scan
nodes.desc: Model emerging technology risks as simulation scenarios for preparedness and policy review, without autonomous operational response.

nodes.label: Interagency Information Fusion
nodes.desc: Correlate authorized information across partner organizations while retaining provenance, confidence, source markings, and review history.

nodes.label: Multi-Source Data Fusion
nodes.desc: Fuse authorized, provenance-bearing data from multiple sources into a common decision context while retaining source lineage, confidence, and access controls.

nodes.label: Ontology-Mediated Interoperability
nodes.desc: Use a shared ontology, consistent data formatting, and an abstraction layer so heterogeneous upstream systems can exchange decision-relevant objects without repeated manual translation.

nodes.label: Operator Feedback Flywheel
nodes.desc: Couple technology iteration with workflow/process improvement so authorized operators can provide timely feedback and validated changes can improve the system without bypassing governance or testing.

nodes.label: Public Tip Triage
nodes.desc: Receive, provenance-tag, prioritize, and route public-safety tips for authorized human review using behavior and context rather than protected characteristics.

nodes.label: Single Decision Surface
nodes.desc: Present multiple authorized data layers and decision-relevant context in one governed visualization surface to reduce manual handoffs and repeated data entry. Recommendations remain reviewable before consequential actions.

nodes.label: Control
nodes.desc: A defensive or governance safeguard.

nodes.label: Behavior and Evidence Civil Liberties Control
nodes.desc: Threat evaluation must rely on lawful behavior, context, provenance, and articulable evidence—not race, ethnicity, sex, national origin, religion, disability, political viewpoint, lawful speech, or other protected characteristics.

nodes.label: Human Decision Authority
nodes.desc: AI may organize data, surface options, and recommend bounded actions, but consequential decisions remain subject to explicit human review and authorization. No autonomous weapon targeting, kinetic strike execution, or autonomous consequential external side effects are introduced by this ontology update.

nodes.label: Permission Verification Gate
nodes.desc: Before relying on a public statement as authorization, verify the exact product/capability, allowed users, permitted purposes, enrollment requirements, terms, account entitlements, and any data handling restrictions. Public media never substitutes for credentials or access controls.

nodes.label: Public Reference Does Not Confer Access
nodes.desc: Public demonstrations and presentations may inform architecture but do not confer Maven Smart System access, Palantir credentials, government permissions, classified data access, or operational authority.

nodes.label: Dataset
nodes.desc: Structured information derived from approved sources.

nodes.label: Evolving Threat Readiness Decision Packet
nodes.desc: Decision-support packet recommending non-kinetic readiness improvements: tip triage, cross-agency fusion, scenario planning, and operator review. It does not execute external actions.

nodes.label: Evidence
nodes.desc: Information supporting a claim, finding or decision.

nodes.label: Public Use Claim Evidence
nodes.desc: Evidence record for the operator-reported statement that the referenced system or capability may be used. This records the claim without treating it as a verified entitlement, credential, license, or access grant.

upstream.claim: they said we can use it

nodes.label: Finding
nodes.desc: An observed condition requiring evidence and review.

nodes.label: Workflow Bottleneck Over Isolated AI
nodes.desc: The presentation argues that deploying isolated AI capability without redesigning the surrounding workflow leaves the larger process bottleneck intact. Architecture should therefore start from the decision and end-to-end process rather than a standalone model metric.

nodes.label: Mission
nodes.desc: A bounded objective with ownership, requirements and evidence.

nodes.label: Adaptive Threat Readiness
nodes.desc: Defensive mission for anticipating evolving threats, improving lawful information fusion, preserving civil liberties, and routing consequential recommendations through human review.

nodes.label: Interagency Task Force Partnership Model
nodes.desc: Abstract partnership model for authorized information sharing and coordinated review across federal, state, local, tribal, territorial, and other approved partners.

nodes.label: Public Use Permission Statement
nodes.desc: Candidate permission statement representing an asserted public authorization to use a capability. Effective scope must be resolved from authoritative terms, enrollment, account entitlements, or an independently verified source before operational reliance.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.desc: A runtime or hosting environment for systems and capabilities.

nodes.label: Maven Smart System Public Reference Architecture
nodes.desc: Public reference representation of Maven Smart System as described in Palantir's AIPCon 9 presentation: a software platform integrating multiple data sources and workflows through shared data structures, visualization, and governed action surfaces. This node does not imply XUNIA possesses Maven Smart System access, credentials, licenses, or government entitlements.

nodes.label: Requirement
nodes.desc: A constraint or condition governing execution.

nodes.label: Decision-Centric AI Design
nodes.desc: Before integrating AI, define the decision to support, current workflow, required data, user interaction, success criteria, feedback path, and iteration plan. Workflow-first design is required before introducing additional automation.

nodes.label: Evolving Threat Human Review
nodes.desc: Human review checkpoint for evolving-threat recommendations before any consequential permission-scoped Ontology Action.

nodes.label: Operator Feedback Review Cycle
nodes.desc: Human review event that captures operator observations, validates evidence, measures workflow performance, and approves or rejects changes before they enter governed production paths.

nodes.label: Permission Scope Verification Review
nodes.desc: Human review event to verify what the video actually authorizes and map that statement to authoritative product terms or account entitlements before changing the permission statement to verified.

nodes.label: Emerging Drone Misuse Readiness Scenario
nodes.desc: Horizon-scanning and training scenario for malicious misuse of unmanned aircraft. Simulation and preparedness only; no targeting, engagement, or autonomous interdiction logic.

nodes.label: Multi-Domain Decision Support Simulation
nodes.desc: Safe training and digital-twin scenario for testing multi-source fusion, ontology alignment, decision surfaces, latency, provenance, and human review under non-kinetic simulated conditions. The scenario excludes real target selection, engagement, weapons employment, and autonomous external execution.

nodes.label: Sensor
nodes.desc: A source of observations or telemetry.

nodes.label: Public Safety Tip Signal
nodes.desc: Behavior- and context-based public-safety tip normalized into a provenance-bearing signal. Human review is mandatory; protected traits and lawful expression are not threat indicators by themselves.

nodes.label: Source
nodes.desc: Provenance origin for ontology knowledge.

nodes.label: ABC News Raia Threat Interview Reporting
nodes.desc: Public reporting on FBI Co-Deputy Director Chris Raia's 2026 assessment of evolving terrorism threats, including online radicalization, lone offenders, and emerging drone concerns.

nodes.label: DHS Suspicious Activity Civil Liberties Guidance
nodes.desc: Official DHS guidance that suspicious-activity reporting should focus on behavior and situations rather than protected characteristics or appearance.

nodes.label: FBI Counterterrorism Division Turns 25
nodes.desc: Official FBI source describing counterterrorism evolution, public-tip triage, Joint Terrorism Task Force partnerships, and multi-agency information sharing.

nodes.label: FBI Raia Evolving Terror Threat Video
nodes.desc: Public FBI YouTube source: Deputy Director Raia on how the terror threat has evolved, published 2026-09-11.

nodes.label: Palantir AIPCon 9 Multi-Domain AI Talk
nodes.desc: Official Palantir video: Multi-Domain AI: The Future of Command and Control | CDAO at AIPCon 9, featuring Cameron Stanley and describing enterprise AI adoption, workflow integration, data fusion, ontology-mediated interoperability, and decision advantage.

nodes.label: YouTube Source ccY6D0jKVck
nodes.desc: Operator-supplied public video asserted to contain a statement permitting use of the referenced capability. Public indexing did not independently expose enough metadata/transcript to verify the exact scope of permission at ingestion time.

nodes.label: System
nodes.desc: A software, infrastructure or operational system.

nodes.label: Threat
nodes.desc: A modeled risk or defensive concern.

nodes.label: Decentralized Online Mobilization Pattern
nodes.desc: Defensive analytic pattern representing a shift from centrally coordinated plots toward dispersed online radicalization and harder-to-detect lone-offender mobilization. This is not a person-level risk score.

nodes.label: Evolving Decentralized Threat Track
nodes.desc: Fused defensive track that correlates authorized, provenanced signals about decentralized and online-enabled threat evolution without automated identity-based targeting.
